answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the lagoon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the karst of the next round. The ferrous of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
